findingDetails.title: The feature catalog omits Vibe from both hand-over runtime enumerations and carries no entry for the Vibe compaction re-injection tier, so the two features this branch ships are absent from the feature index

The packet's open-lead text attributes the VIB-HK-005 save-nudge failure to e5b8611a4fa changing turn-start.mjs, but that file's diff is purely additive, so the lead sends the next reader to a file the commit did not change behaviourally

traceabilityChecks.notes: Unchanged from iteration 2; the cross-reference pass adds no new spec claim.
The session-lifecycle and session-handover READMEs match the code; only the turn-start.mjs header is stale (R4-P2-001).
No agent profile changed in the 2026-11-15 fixes.
feature-catalog.md:1096 omits Vibe from both hand-over enumerations and the file has no compaction re-injection entry (R5-P2-001).

noveltyJustification: Both findings are new and neither refines a prior one: R5-P2-001 is the first finding against the feature catalog, and R5-P2-002 is the first against the packet's own open-lead framing. Weighted new = 1 + 1 = 2 over weighted total 2.
ruledOut: Part ordering as the VIB-HK-005 cause: composeTurnStart awaits each part sequentially and the save nudge sits at index 3, before the appended handoverPart
A consume-without-inject defect in the save nudge: takeNudge returns the count it stores, so the reminder and the cursor advance together
The feature catalog being uniformly Vibe-blind: feature-catalog.md:1112 names Vibe as a history-lookup sender, so the gap is two specific sections
A duplicate between R2-P2-001 and R5-P2-001: different files, different claims
A contradiction among the ten active findings: each names a distinct file and line
